Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EmberTech SIG questionnaire — initial drop and timeline request

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached is EmberTech's standard SIG questionnaire (v3). We are trying to close procurement and security review by the end of next week. Can you confirm:

- Who at Redwood will own the control mapping and evidence delivery?
- Whether you can provide artifacts for the items highlighted in column D by Friday 8/6?
- If there are any controls you map to a compensating control we should be aware of?

If it's easier, happy to take a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow to go over the higher-risk items.

Thanks,
Avery Stone
Security & Compliance Lead
EmberTech

Team — forwarding EmberTech's questionnaire. They want a control mapping and artifacts for a subset by Friday. High level ask: can we run an "evidence sprint" and split ownership?

Proposed ownership (please confirm by EOD):
- Control mapping & crosswalk doc: Marissa
- Artifact collection & permissions (drive bundle): Neha
- Technical clarifications / kernel/runtime questions: Karthik
- I'll own logistics, hubspot record, and call scheduling.

Notes: Ember flagged privacy/data retention and vendor isolation as higher risk. If you see any items we cannot support as-is, call them out and propose compensating controls.

Jordan
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Jordan / team —

Confirmed — I'll own the control mapping. Plan for the next 72 hours:
1) Quick pass: identify all SIG items that map to our SOC2/ISO controls (deliverable: redwood_control_crosswalk.pdf) — due 8/4 EOD.
2) Artifact manifest: Neha will build a short list of required artifacts and permissions. We'll note which ones are already public (docs, whitepapers) vs. ones that need redaction or gated sharing.
3) Risk notes: Karthik, please review the highlighted runtime/quantization items — I'll call those 'technical exceptions' in the mapping if needed.
4) Final pass & hand-off to Jordan for delivery and EmberTech call scheduling by 8/5.

Questions for Neha: can you create a single shared GDrive folder with restricted viewer access and a simple CSV manifest for the artifacts? Also flag anything that requires legal review (contracts, subprocessors).

I'll start the crosswalk now and send a PDF drop as soon as it's ready.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Manager, Redwood Inference

All —

Folder created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEmberTech-RFI
CSV manifest (attached) lists required artifacts and suggested filenames. Quick summary of artifacts we can provide within 48 hours:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — filename: SOC2_Redwood_redacted.pdf
- ISO 27001 scope statement & certificate — filename: ISO27001_certificate.pdf
- Subprocessor list (current) — filename: subprocessor_list.csv
- Network architecture diagram (redacted) — filename: network_arch_redacted.pdf
- Logging & retention policy excerpt — filename: logging_retention_excerpt.pdf

Two items that need legal sign-off before sharing:
- Full SOC2 bridge letters (legal requested review)
- Raw audit logs (PII-sensitive) — propose providing a sanitized sample and an architecture description instead.

I'll upload the initial bundle and attach the evidence_manifest.csv. Tagging which artifacts correspond to which SIG questions in the manifest.

Neha
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 13:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EmberTech SIG questionnaire — initial drop and timeline request

Marissa / team —

Reviewed the technical flags. Quick notes to include in the mapping:
- Runtime isolation: our multi-tenant hosted offering uses container+VM isolation plus request-level prefix KV separation; point them to the network_arch_redacted.pdf and include the runtime isolation section from the crosswalk.
- Quantization/accuracy: where the SIG asks about determinism, we'll map to our model-variant policy and note that we can provide a determinism statement per-model for EmberTech's pinned production model.
- Logging: we will not provide raw full-volume logs; propose a sanitized log sample + explanation on log retention and access controls.

I'll add three short technical annotation rows to the crosswalk PDF before Marissa finalizes it.

Karthik
Principal Applied ML Engineer
Redwood Inference
